title: Replace HubSpot: Build Your Own Marketing and CRM Tool With AI
summary: HubSpot costs $800-1,200/month for a small team. Here's how to build your own CRM and marketing tool with AI in a weekend — and keep $30K/year in your pocket.
body_markdown: For most small and mid-size teams: yes. If your actual workflow is contact management, a deal pipeline, email campaigns, and a reporting dashboard — you're using roughly 20% of what HubSpot offers. Blink can build those four features in a weekend. The database is included, auth is built in, and hosting is included. What a custom tool won't replicate quickly is HubSpot's mature behavioral automation engine or its enterprise governance features — but most teams don't use those either.
